hypothesis: The 52 never-consumed C32 success sources yield at least eight fresh within-state mixed ranking groups across at least three LIBERO suites while preserving exact action consequences.
single_variable: Within each bit-exact restored trial8..11 state, only the first-replan policy diffusion seed changes; the first chunk executes up to 32 steps and every continuation uses the same replan8 seed schedule.
parent_baseline: C30 produced 25 train mixed groups but only 3 validation mixed groups against a preregistered requirement of 4 and was retained as FAIL; C32 then passed with 52 wholly new successful trial8..11 sources.

references.title: FACT: A Failure-Aware Causal Transformer for World Action Models
FACT clean-action conditioned future and value data path

architecture.paper: Future/value targets follow clean executed actions from a fixed policy.
architecture.upstream_code: FACT collects observed future and value labels without changing the sampled action.
architecture.local: C33 freezes D0-H32-s14000 and changes only first-action diffusion seed.

data.upstream_code: Evaluation episodes are distinct from fitting records.
data.local: All 52 C32 trial8..11 successes supply d3/d5 states; all 104 groups are marked fresh_ranking_val.
data.rationale: No C21-C30 branch used these trials.

action.paper: Observed consequences condition on executed action tokens.
action.upstream_code: FACT uses clean actions; MiniWorld aligns action chunks to video time.
action.local: Exact result/trajectory 32x7 proposal is retained and terminal execution length is audited for later tail masking.
action.rationale: The model-free collection preserves enough information to distinguish proposal from executed prefix.

objective.paper: Value/ranking needs success and failure outcomes.
objective.local: C33 requires at least eight mixed groups over at least three suites plus complete consequences.
objective.rationale: This gates later value ranking and is not itself an optimization objective.

optimization.local: Zero parameter updates; 416 simulator branches run over 32 GPUs.

evaluation.paper: Held-out value is judged on unseen rollouts.
evaluation.upstream_code: Evaluation keeps episode identity and outcomes.
evaluation.local: All branches require terminal/replan consequences, exact actions, fixed continuations and mixed outcomes before any ranking evaluation.
evaluation.rationale: Passing authorizes a later model comparison, not a LIBERO effect claim.

evidence: 52 sources, 104 states, 416 branches frozen before C33 outcomes
first chunk32; continuation replan8; exact action/trajectory audit
eight mixed groups and three-suite threshold fixed

decision.rationale: C30's fixed validation gate failed and is not relaxed; C33 spends bounded rollout compute to create a genuinely untouched validation set large enough for consequence-value ranking.
